title: Full Stack Tech Lead
jobDescription: Simnovus is looking for a Full Stack Tech Lead who can mentor a high-performing engineering team while staying hands-on in building scalable, data-heavy products. You will set the technical direction, mentor developers, ensure architectural strength, and drive on-time, high-quality delivery. If you excel at solving complex problems, working with Golang, Java Script frameworks, microservices, and modern data technologies-and are excited to thrive in a fastmoving startup environment-this role is for you. You will set the technical direction, mentor developers, ensure architectural strength, and drive on-time, high-quality delivery. If you excel at solving complex problems, working with Golang, Java Script frameworks, microservices, and modern data technologies-and are excited to thrive in a fastmoving startup environment-this role is for you. If you excel at solving complex problems, working with Golang, Java Script frameworks, microservices, and modern data technologies-and are excited to thrive in a fastmoving startup environment-this role is for you. You will set the technical direction, mentor developers, ensure architectural strength, and drive on-time, high-quality delivery. If you excel at solving complex problems, working with Golang, Java Script frameworks, microservices, and modern data technologies-and are excited to thrive in a fastmoving startup environment-this role is for you. Qualifications MUST HAVE: Experience in building products that require handling a huge volume of data and building dashboards Good Programming ability with Golang Experience in Java Script & JS Frameworks (Angular JS, React, node JS). Good problem-solving skills to break down complex issue into smaller achievable tasks Experience in implementing REST web services. Experience in database technology such as Mongo DB/Postgre SQL and any timescale database like Influx DB. Experience in building and designing microservices and cloud-native applications. Experience in container management with Kubernetes/Podman and Docker. Experience in Messaging Queue and Optimization of data handling GOOD TO HAVE: Frontend, developing product in Wireless domain, AI implementation to optimize the calculation or to predict result Minimum years of experience: 10 yrs with 5-7 yrs of experience in the must have skills Deep Knowledge of front-end languages such as HTML, and CSS. Good working knowledge of Unix/Linux Environments. Knowledge of any cloud platform is an added advantage. Proficient in writing unit test cases. Should have some experience in writing component-level testing e.g. Behave test cases Exposure to product development related to the data and wireless technologies Responsibilities Leading a team and its alignment in the right technical direction. Collaborating with the Chief Product officer to ensure that the architecture of the product is robust to meet the scalability requirements. Mentoring the team members to build their competence and ensuring that the team has a collective commitment towards the product goals. Coordinating with the Product Management team to understand the product requirement and ensure it is properly passed on to the team. Providing accurate effort estimates for the requirement and ensuring delivery on time. Accountable for the quality of the technical deliverables of the team. Helping the team in overcoming any technical challenges they encounter.
